name: Image Upload
description: Upload PNG and JPEG images to a shared public gallery and view them full size
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may view the gallery and the image files; require auth for uploading images, and only the uploader may delete an image (403 for anyone else); admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

POST /api/images takes a JSON body with filename (the original file name, required, at most 255 characters), data (the file's bytes, base64-encoded) and an optional title of at most 100 characters; the response describes the stored image
Accepted formats are PNG and JPEG; any other data, data that is not valid base64, or an empty file answers 400; files larger than 5 MB after decoding answer 413
Each stored image records its content_type (image/png or image/jpeg), size_bytes and a url (the path of GET /api/images/:id/file) the frontend can use directly in an image element
GET /api/images/:id/file returns the stored bytes unchanged with the image's content type; two uploads with the same filename are kept as separate images
GET /api/images returns active images, newest first; ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 24, at most 100), and total counts every active image
DELETE /api/images/:id removes the image and its stored file permanently
Deactivated images (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/images and answer 404 on the public image endpoints, file included; the admin overview still lists them

Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for deleting someone else's image or a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 413 for files over 5 MB
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the gallery; signed-in users also get the upload form and a delete button on their own images, and visitors see a 'Sign in to upload images' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Gallery: a responsive grid of thumbnails with title (or filename), uploader and date, previous/next paging, and an empty state when there are no images
Clicking a thumbnail opens the image full size with its filename, title and file size

Upload form: a file picker limited to PNG and JPEG, an optional title, a preview of the chosen image before uploading, and the API's error message when an upload is rejected; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every image, active or not, with uploader and size and total, active and inactive counts
Toggle an image's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: List active images, newest first, paged
Upload an image (JSON body with the base64-encoded file)
The stored image bytes, served with the image's content type (not JSON)
Delete one of the signed-in user's images

data_models.name: Image
data_models.description: An uploaded PNG or JPEG image; the bytes are stored by the app and served from its file endpoint

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who uploaded it)
fields.filename: string (required, max 255 chars; the original file name)
fields.title: string (optional, max 100 chars)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the image from public endpoints)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every image with counts
